# Identity = SHA-256 of `strategy_Portfolio.xml` without `makeExternal` and `autoGenerated`
`core.sqxfile.identity()` strips both attributes: a retest rewrites `makeExternal`, and after the MC
Retest SQX drops `autoGenerated="true"` from every `<variable>` in place (stripped since 2026-09-27,
owner). Identities stored before that date, of strategies still carrying the attribute, use the old
formula — rerun the harvest to regenerate. Names are not keys; `structure()` = block keys in order.
WFM rewrites parameters, so its files are genuinely other strategies (`identity-differs-across-databanks`).

## Evidence
2026-09-26, `Test_USDJPY_donchianUpperCrossUp_M30/OOS`: gate verdict identities (22:37) matched the
files at 22:38; after crossmarket + MC Retest all 8 differed. `diff` against a verbatim copy taken at
22:45 (`AlgoData/crosstf/.../Strategy 3.8.61.sqx`): only `autoGenerated="true"` gone from 4 `<variable>`.
- The member holds definition, no results (those are in `Results/*/dailyEquity.bin`, `orders.bin`,
  `settings.xml`).
- `XAU_ISOOS_ejemplo` pair: 335 lines each side, 29 differing, all `makeExternal`. Raw hash matched
  **0 of 115**; normalised **115 of 115**, identical to the filename pairing.
- 📓 Not: "raw identity survives a retest" (5/5 between `XAUUSD/SPP IS` and `SPP OOS`) — both sides had
  already been retested; a control that passes by accident of the material.
- `Strategy 17.8.29` in `XAUUSD/OOS` and `XAUUSD/MC Trades` are different strategies
  (`StructuralBreakFilters_EntryOnly` vs `DirectionalMomentumFilters_EntryExit`, 281 vs 355 lines); of
  231 and 757 files only 4 names collide, all of this kind.
- `XAUUSD/MC Trades`: 757 `.sqx`, 694 distinct identities — 63 exact copies in their own databank.
- `structure()`: the 115 survivors = **24 structures**, two with 32 strategies each. 0.2 ms per strategy,
  0.18 s to read 235 files.
